name: Floor - The Council
text: I have written to the council. I have also written to you, but the council will act.

name: Floor - No Room
text: {hours} hours without a room. I stood in your lobby like furniture, and furniture at least gets sat on.

name: Floor - Nowhere To Sit
text: {hours} hours. I waited {hours} hours to sit down. I am told that is not a record.

name: Floor - Nothing To Do
text: {hours} hours and nothing happened. Nothing at all. I checked twice.

name: Floor - Nothing To Eat
text: {hours} hours, no food, and I would like that painted on the front of the building.

name: Poor - Let Them Wonder
text: I expected more. I will not be saying what. Let them wonder.

name: Poor - No Sleep
text: I did not sleep. {hours} hours of not sleeping, in a hotel, which is the one thing a hotel is for.

name: Poor - Standing
text: I would like it noted that I spent {hours} hours upright. Standing. In a hotel.

name: Poor - Nothing To Do
text: Nothing to do for {hours} hours. I have been through my own pockets twice and found nothing.

name: Poor - Empty Stomach
text: {hours} hours without food. I am writing this on an empty stomach and I think it shows.

name: Fair - It Was A Hotel
text: It was a hotel. It was, I suppose, a hotel.

name: Fair - The Ceiling
text: Slept badly. {hours} hours of ceiling. I know that ceiling now. We are acquainted.

name: Fair - Coat Rack
text: Pleasant enough. Nowhere to sit for {hours} hours. I stood in the lobby like a coat rack.

name: Fair - Hotels With Rooms
text: It was a hotel. It had rooms. I have stayed in hotels with rooms before.

name: Fair - The Sandwich
text: I did not travel all this way to spend {hours} hours queueing for a sandwich. I say that as a patient man.

name: Good - My Wife Disagrees
text: Nearly perfect. My wife disagrees, but she disagrees professionally.

name: Good - The Traffic
text: Good hotel. I was awake for {hours} hours of it, which I have decided to blame on the traffic.

name: Good - Not A Young Man
text: Very nearly perfect. {hours} hours without a chair. I am not a young man and I made this known.

name: Good - United In Nothing
text: Lovely place. Nothing whatever to do in it. Others were also doing nothing, so at least we were united.

name: Good - Would Eat First
text: Would return. Would eat first.

name: Top - Hard To Please
text: Nothing to report. I am told I am hard to please. I am not hard to please.

name: Top - Woke Once
text: Slept like a stone. Woke once. Went back to sleep. That is the entire report.

name: Top - I Like Standing
text: Everything was fine. I stood for a while, but I like standing. My wife says I do not.

name: Top - I Brought A Book
text: Faultless. There was nothing to do, but I had brought a book, so that one is on me.

name: Top - Ignore The Man
text: No notes. Ignore the man complaining about the food, he never stopped eating it.
